name: Checkbox
description: A native boolean choice, or an indeterminate summary of the choices below it, beside a visible label.

checked.description: Controlled selection. Indeterminate summarizes a partially selected collection; it does not submit a value.

defaultChecked.description: Uncontrolled initial selection, also restored by form reset.

label.description: Visible label content. Empty content adds no label slot; zero remains visible.

aria-label.description: Accessible name, including when there is no visible label.

aria-labelledby.description: External label element IDs; takes native precedence over aria-label.

disabled.description: Exclude the checkbox from activation, focus navigation and form submission.

required.description: Require an actual checked value for native form validation; mixed is not checked.

name.description: FormData key. Without a name the checkbox does not contribute a field.

value.description: Value submitted only when checked. It does not control selection.

form.description: ID of an external native form that owns the input.

autoFocus.description: Focus the native input on mount.

fullWidth.description: Expand the membrane and clickable label to the container width.

membrane.description: Shared outer spacing; toggling it preserves input identity and state.

behavior.stateModel: A boolean choice or indeterminate collection summary. Native activation changes to true or false.
behavior.controlledValue: Parent checked updates apply while disabled without emitting user callbacks.
behavior.uncontrolledValue: defaultChecked initializes selection and is restored by form reset.
behavior.disabled: Native disabled inputs do not activate or submit.
behavior.nativeEvents: onChange runs before onCheckedChange. preventDefault() in onClick or onChange cancels the activation: the browser rolls it back and nothing is reported.

notes: The visible label uses implicit native association. aria-labelledby and aria-label keep their native precedence.
Indeterminate renders aria-checked=mixed and is restored on the native DOM before paint.
Keep label typography delegated to Text rather than checkbox-local font classes.
